news.headline: Clingan amassed 10 points (5-5 FG), 10 rebounds, five blocks, one assist and one steal across 22 minutes during Monday's 106-98 loss to the Timberwolves.
news.story: Clingan didn't miss a shot and led the Trail Blazers in rebounds en route to his second straight double-double. The big man was also active on the defensive end, racking up a game-high five blocks. He's recorded multiple swats and double-digit boards in four straight games, averaging 8.8 points, 11.5 rebounds, 3.0 blocks, 2.0 assists and 1.0 steals across 26.3 minutes per contest during that span.

However, the eight turnovers were a significant blemish on an otherwise outstanding performance. With Dylan Harper (groin) expected to miss one to three weeks, Castle could see additional ball-handling responsibilities, boosting his upside as a secondary…

news.headline: Stephon Castle somehow gets the and-1 to fall
Castle chipped in 10 points (3-11 FG, 2-5 3Pt, 2-4 FT), two rebounds and seven assists over 31 minutes during Tuesday's 105-93 loss to the Pistons.
news.story: Castle cooled off after a torrid two-game stretch that included a 32-point outburst against Golden State. He still led San Antonio in assists, but he couldn't find the range in a game where the Spurs' offense stalled down the stretch. The third-year guard is averaging 15.7 points and 5.4 assists. With Dylan Harper (undisclosed) listed as day-to-day, Castle could see even more ball-handling duties in the coming games.
